answer: Because the timing is recorded against the gale challenge, the karst audit can replay the pulse history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 97 submissions and hold each member open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 334 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
